name: multi-gpu-template
_comment: TEMPLATE for multiple GPUs - adjust before using. Two environment variables are mandatory on multi-GPU AMD setups: without NCCL_PROTO=Simple, tensor-parallel deadlocks on the first all-reduce; without NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1, a four-card host can hang at random. Also note these cards have no XGMI, so every byte between them crosses PCIe. FIXED 2026-09-30: tensor split written with '/' (llama-bench syntax) -- the earlier ',' form made llama-bench sweep four values of '1' = everything on GPU 0, which is what failed with 'failed to load model'.
